notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.11
notes.notes: A small hotfix to address the inability to unlock Steam Achievements. These should now correctly get unlocked when performed. You might have to redo some of them to trigger the achievement.

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.06.05
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been great to see the reception of Kyoto Anomaly, and whilst the experience has been mainly bugfree, there were a few QoL issues that popped up that we wanted to address. 

Should you run into some other bugs or have QoL requests, please let us know through either the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3631850/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], or our [url=https://discord.gg/WSus22f8aM]Discord server[/url]. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the player movement system, so you no longer lose your momentum when touching walls or other objects.
[*] Fixed a bug with 2 anomalies where they could spawn too early ([spoiler]fog entity and chasing oni[/spoiler]), leading to a condition where you couldn't escape them killing you. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.05.29
notes.notes: A small hotfix so that the "Anomaly Tourist" now includes a specific anomaly in it's checks that all anomalies have been seen. You should no longer receive the achievement with one anomaly still locked.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
A question we often get asked is whether we support Steam Deck, and the answer to that is a resounding yes.

This post is just to give you a bit more of an idea of what to expect while we're waiting on Steam's official rating.

[h2]Performance[/h2]
By default, the game will run at 60FPS locked out of the box, you can decrease your TDP to 10W and still get a smooth 60FPS experience.

Should power saving be your passion, our game also comes with basic graphic quality settings, allowing you to drop down to 5W TDP and maintain a smooth 60FPS experience, at the cost of reduced visual fidelity.

[h2]Support[/h2]
Should you still experience some issues with Deck, you can let us know through either [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3631850/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/WSus22f8aM]Discord server[/url].
